lines.zh: 我踩着空气走，脚下有紫色裂纹
lines.en: I walk on air, purple cracks under my feet.

lines.zh: 身子红黑交杂，走起来像在碎
lines.en: My red-black body seems to shatter as I move.
The sword at my hip knocks with each step.

lines.zh: 我走的路会自己歪一点
lines.en: The road bends slightly where I walk.
My feet don't touch down, but my shadow does.
I pass through a tree; the tree remains.

lines.zh: 空间在我身边响了一声
lines.en: Space clicks once beside me.
One step at a time; I can't rush this.

lines.zh: 这种身体走起来很不实在
lines.en: This body doesn't feel solid when it moves.

lines.zh: 我斜着过去，看着像折了
lines.en: I move at an angle, looking folded.

lines.zh: 路上留下紫痕，很快消失
lines.en: Purple marks trail behind and fade fast.
Where I want to be, I lean that way.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，世界有点偏
lines.en: I stand here and the world tilts a little.
My sword turns once in my hand.

lines.zh: 空间在我背后裂了一道
lines.en: A crack opens in space behind me.

lines.zh: 我呼吸的样子，是装出来的
lines.en: My breathing is an act.
All sounds nearby grow distant.
I laugh, and no sound comes.

lines.zh: 身体在重组，一遍又一遍
lines.en: My body reassembles, again and again.

lines.zh: 这块地被我的气弄脏了
lines.en: My ki has soiled this ground.
I count the gaps; seven of them.
I raise a hand, lightning between my fingers.
I'm waiting for someone to come near.
Even the quiet air seems to tremble.
They call this place the underworld.
Standing here, I block the way.
Look at me, don't blink.
You won't be able to remember this face.

lines.zh: 你的影子歪了，是我的错
lines.en: Your shadow's crooked; that's my doing.
Didn't you hear me speak?
There's a crack in you now.

lines.zh: 我在看你，也在看你身后
lines.en: I'm watching you, and behind you.
You're a little cleaner than this place.
Don't leave; you'll come back anyway.

lines.zh: 你的心跳在这里回音很长
lines.en: Your heartbeat echoes a long time here.
Come here, let me see your bones.

lines.zh: 这一带有我，就不该有别人
lines.en: With me here, no one else belongs.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候，你最好别笑
lines.en: When I laugh, you'd best not.

lines.zh: 你的脸在变，你察觉了吗
lines.en: Your face is changing; have you noticed?

lines.zh: 我从不杀人，我只让东西错位
lines.en: I never kill; I only put things out of place.
Stop, you're standing on my crack.
That you can see me is enough.
I'll leave you one path.
Turn around before you speak.

lines.zh: 这一下落在我身上，位置歪了
lines.en: The blow landed off-center.
The wound closed, but crooked.
I laugh, and the sound is farther.

lines.zh: 身体散开一点，又拼回来
lines.en: My body comes apart a little, then rejoins.
You struck empty space.
My sword rings once.
Space shuddered with me.

lines.zh: 疼是有的，只是不在这里
lines.en: There is pain, just not here.
I gave half a step, and half is enough.
There's one more crack now.
Food is empty to me.

lines.zh: 你把甜食举起来，我笑了
lines.en: You raise sweets; I laughed.
That scent passes through me.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只吃空间
lines.en: I eat no food, only space.

lines.zh: 你要是给我一条裂缝，我倒有兴趣
lines.en: Give me a crack and I'd be interested.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在我眼里是虚的
lines.en: What's in your hand looks unreal to me.
I'm not hungry, never was.
Put it down, don't waste it.
This belongs somewhere else.
I took it, and I still won't eat.

lines.zh: 你撞过我的时候，位置变了
lines.en: When you bumped me, you moved elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我这身不实在，你穿过去了
lines.en: This body isn't solid; you passed through.
Don't get close, things slip.
I shifted half a step and the path bent.

lines.zh: 你的脚现在踩空了一寸
lines.en: Your foot is an inch off the ground now.
Touch me and you'll feel cold.
I don't push; I relocate.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你心里乱了一下
lines.en: That bump unsettled your mind.
Back away, you're on a crack.

lines.zh: 空间把我们一起挤了一下
lines.en: Space squeezed us both for a moment.
That concept doesn't hold for me.
I have no shape, and no partner.
The only kin I have is a mirror.

lines.zh: 我不会留下东西在这世上
lines.en: I won't leave anything in this world.

lines.zh: 你来我这边，也不会有结果
lines.en: Even if you come over, nothing comes of it.

lines.zh: 我只把自己重组很多次
lines.en: I only reassemble myself, many times.
Stop asking; space is ringing.
This body is pieced together.
There's no path between us.
Do as you like; I won't answer.
I reach out and the thing comes to me.
It was always here.
I pick it up and its position is wrong.
I don't bend; the ground just empties.
This belongs elsewhere.
I pick it up and my fingers pass through.
This part is mine.

lines.zh: 我放在口袋里，口袋不在
lines.en: I put it in a pocket, and there is no pocket.
Stow it, or it falls into the crack.

lines.zh: 地上这些，都是别人丢的
lines.en: These on the ground are things others lost.
I see your ki; it's bright.
You can't take this road.
Space splits open first.
I'm behind you, not ahead.

lines.zh: 你的位置已经被我记住了
lines.en: I've memorized your position.
First, let the air tighten.
This one will run; I block the way.

lines.zh: 地面不平，那就更不平一点
lines.en: The ground's uneven; let's make it worse.
A giant ape's roar sits in my throat.
Just this one is enough.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我能伸手拿到
lines.en: At this distance I can reach him.
I turn the sound far away.

lines.zh: 锁定，你已经不在原来的位置
lines.en: Locked; you're no longer where you were.

lines.zh: 我挪半步，你就偏了一格
lines.en: I shift half a step and you're off by a block.
Sword light skims the ground.

lines.zh: 他在找我的位置，找不到
lines.en: He's looking for my position and can't find it.
A ki barrier stands between us.
Strike me and I'm on the other side.

lines.zh: 速度不重要，位置才重要
lines.en: Speed doesn't matter; placement does.
His hands shake, and space shakes.
Another crack to box him in.
Don't look back; there's more behind.
Feints are my specialty.
The sword is already raised.
He comes forward, so I slip back.
I won't take this one; I yield.

lines.zh: 他的路线有两处会错位
lines.en: Two points on his route will distort.
I'm waiting for him to miss a step.
The ape beam needs three breaths.
Now, pull the space in.
Sword light passes at an angle.
My charged rush lifts him off the ground.

lines.zh: 魔人拳打在他胸口，位置偏了半寸
lines.en: The Majin punch lands half an inch off center.

lines.zh: 空中连击，我一直在上面
lines.en: An aerial combo; I stay above.
The ki laser splits the ground.

lines.zh: 巨猿咆哮，空气被推出去
lines.en: The ape roar shoves the air out.
The barrier goes up and he can't retreat.

lines.zh: 我穿过他，再回身补一下
lines.en: I pass through him and strike on the way back.

lines.zh: 这一剑落在他的影子上
lines.en: This cut lands on his shadow.
He's been relocated.

lines.zh: 空间一合，他整个人一沉
lines.en: Space closes and he sinks.
I laugh once, and the sound is far.

lines.zh: 他挡住了，剑却穿了过去
lines.en: He blocked, and the sword went through.
Two more, don't let him set his feet.

lines.zh: 收剑，看他还在不在原地
lines.en: I sheathe and see if he's still where he was.
No wound this time, only a void.
Space cracks and I step out.
The underworld air changed first.
I'm squeezed out of a crack.
This scene should feel wrong to you.
No ground under me, and I stand.
My voice arrives before my body.
This isn't spawning; it's an error.

lines.zh: 我从不自然的自然生成里来
lines.en: I come from what shouldn't spawn.

lines.zh: 紫黑色的气从地面冒起来
lines.en: Purple-black ki rises from the ground.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候没有声音
lines.en: No sound when I land.

lines.zh: 这座竞技场本来就该有观众
lines.en: This arena was always meant to have an audience.
I look up and see no sky.
The sword is already at my hip.
The colors on my body are swapping.
Someone opened a door.

lines.zh: 我从另一头过来，路很短
lines.en: I came from the other side; the way was short.

lines.zh: 世界抖了一下，我站稳了
lines.en: The world shuddered and I steadied.

lines.zh: 你看，我的影子是两层的
lines.en: Look, my shadow has two layers.

lines.zh: 火在我身上找不到可烧的
lines.en: Fire finds nothing on me to burn.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，落地却没有坑
lines.en: I fell from height and left no crater.
The water passes straight through me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推成两半，又合上
lines.en: The blast split me in two, then I rejoined.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去，钉在后面的墙上
lines.en: The arrow goes through and sticks in the wall behind.
The spell and I passed each other by.
I have no body to feed.

lines.zh: 雷打进来，紫黑的气更亮了
lines.en: Lightning struck in and my purple ki brightened.
The void feels like coming home.
